from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = grid[0][0]

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == background for v in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == background for r in range(h)) > h / 2]

    interior = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != background).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        line = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]]
            ]
            line.append(corners[0] if corners.count(corners[0]) == 4 and corners[0] != background else interior)
        out.append(line)
    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]

    divider_rows = [
        r for r in range(h)
        if sum(v == bg for v in grid[r]) > w / 2
    ]
    divider_cols = [
        c for c in range(w)
        if sum(grid[r][c] == bg for r in range(h)) > h / 2
    ]

    # A solid background border at the left is not a divider.
    if divider_cols and divider_cols[0] == 0:
        divider_cols = divider_cols[1:]

    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out_h = len(divider_rows) - 1
    out_w = len(divider_cols) - 1
    out = [[fill for _ in range(out_w)] for _ in range(out_h)]

    for i, r in enumerate(divider_rows):
        out_r = min(i, out_h - 1)
        for j in range(out_w):
            a, b = grid[r][divider_cols[j]], grid[r][divider_cols[j + 1]]
            if a == b and a != bg:
                out[out_r][j] = a

    return out

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]

    # Find the horizontal and vertical separator lines.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == bg for v in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == bg for r in range(h)) > h / 2]

    # Discard solid background margins, which can also look like separators.
    rows = [r for r in rows if any(v != bg for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in cols if any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(h))]

    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        line = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            ]
            line.append(corners[0] if corners[0] != bg and corners.count(corners[0]) == 4 else fill)
        out.append(line)
    return out
